method: Connected Chrome UI actions and rendered DOM observations reported by the release owner. Public guest rehearsal with simulated funds; no live AI or PayPal requests in this workflow.

responsive.laterChange: Compared with this responsive-check revision, cfd1d007 changes one line to prefer the $180 workflow review when continuing a fresh workspace. It does not change layout or styles.

checks: Owner approval reserves $180 from the $300 demo budget.
The competing $160 request is blocked because $120 remains available.
Dropping the capture response records UNKNOWN and preserves the $180 reservation.
Reloading reads the same original order and retains the held budget totals.
Looking up the original order confirms the simulated $180 payment.
Repeating the check retains the same capture ID and totals: $120 available, $0 reserved, and $180 paid.

regressions: Continue workflow selects the fresh $180 workflow request.
The Overview shortcut selects the same uncertain operation.
The cancellation confirmation clears when search changes the selected purchase.
A search with no matching purchase leaves no actionable selection.
A new starter request is created through the guest API and cancelled before dispatch.
The Evidence dropdown selects the requested record and closes the previous inspector.
A session with a confirmed purchase offers an explicit Start fresh demo action.
receiptLimits: The stored provider verification snapshot does not contain its own historical approval version or catalogue SKU. The exported operation and approval binding do contain the current values; matching fields alone do not prove which historical approval version was checked.
The receipt is an unsigned application record. Internal consistency does not establish an external signature or independent provider authenticity.
limitations: These were connected Chrome checks, not an incognito-browser test. Anonymous HTTP access was verified separately.
Responsive checks cover the 21 recorded view and viewport combinations. They do not establish full accessibility or penetration-test coverage.
The repeated browser check compares returned references and budget totals; it does not measure external request counts.
This workflow uses simulated funds only. It does not establish a fresh live AI or PayPal sandbox run.
The independent review checked this record, its source-revision difference, and its wording. It did not rerun browser actions or deployed PostgreSQL tests.
consoleScope: No console entries were recorded in the supplied browser QA result. This file is not a complete retained browser log.

deployedBuildGate.evidenceSource: Deployment logs reviewed by the release owner and supplied to the independent reviewer; no new test run was performed for this record review.
deployedBuildGate.scope: The deployed database and build checks are distinct from the browser workflow and the earlier responsive measurements.
